mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weak labor market and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 40% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals weakening demand and accelerating inflation, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of periods when both HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 40% of periods during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening demand, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 60% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weak labor market and falling consumer demand, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of periods when both UNRATE rises and RSAFS falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 1.0% predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 40% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
